summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 7,000,000 of its own ordinary shares on July 23, 2026, from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 113.2056 pence per share. These purchases are part of the company's existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026. The shares will be cancelled. The filing is a routine share buyback update rather than a special situation event such as a capital return programme or issuer tender offer. No deal terms beyond the daily purchase details are provided. Watch for continued buyback execution under the existing programme.
